set.body: Child of bd-01M379MH86VMN6SNVNRH32G3G6. Implement one lexical Jaccard formula over content lemma sets, exposed to UnitContent/TargetContent strict scoring while preserving the existing SemanticDistance.lexicalJaccard(RecallUnit, NodeSummary) behavior and signature. Prove parity on the existing historical pins and a content-only/identity-insensitive consumer fixture. Agree the no-SourceView adapter seam on Fray #115 before editing. Codex-pair-0923 owns cost.scala lexical scope and a separate lexical test file; Claude-release owns content.scala and structural scorer file.
set.title: [G1/S2a-2 lexical] Port Jaccard scorer to content types
